title: Differences between New Orleans and country music
summary: City bands played more jazz swing; in the country the music was called ragtime.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: When you came to New Orleans, did you find there was much difference in the music between this and the country bands? Much different. It was very different? Much different. What way was it?

Well, the boys here, they had more of a jazz swing. Yeah. We didn't call it Dixieland then, they used to call it jazz. Yeah. And when I was in Tibidale, well, I had them old fellas like Joe Oliver, Freddie Kepler, all them old trumpet players. Well, they used to call it ragtime. Yeah.
Did you ever hear them out in the country? Did they ever go up there?
